boundaries.owner: connection.browserPeer is the installed in-process owner Peer; not a real browser cookie/authentication proof.
boundaries.nonOwner: A real connection.createPeer with synthetic unknown principal tests only the exact-route principal fence, not HTTP credential admission.
boundaries.client: Actual current lib/client.js and Host manifest/bundle are read. A VM registers its factory and three slots without rendering; no DOM, browser, screenshots, visual/layout/interaction proof.
boundaries.execution: One message intent only. No ticket admission, assignment start, Worker, external provider, or alternative GUI/server.
boundaries.cleanup: Runtime disposal and probe-owned SQLite read-only checks precede receipt. Host-store closure, file-lock release and runner process cleanup remain for lead after runner exit.
